_comment: Release smoke matrix. branch: the branch that publishes this MC version; run_matrix.py finds its checkout via `git worktree list`. Jars are derived from that checkout's gradle.properties, so they are always the current release build. accept_experimental: modern Forge parks on vanilla's experimental-settings screen (Fishtastic's DataPackRegistryEvent registries are rated experimental); the run confirms it and reports PASS_WITH_FINDINGS until that is fixed.
